newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius stocks continue fall, sentiment subdued.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius stocks continue fall, sentiment subdued.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius market index, Semdex, fell 2.00 points on Friday to 305.78, reflecting declines in a wide range of stocks and a continuing subdued market sentiment, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 10.21 million rupees on 530,656 shares from 3.48 million rupees on 166,491 shares on Wednesday. The index reached its fifth consecutive year low for 1996.
Although foreign investors were seen active on stocks in the banking sector due to the relatively high trading volumes, market sentiment continued to remain hesitant, brokers said.
One dealer said the stock market was following a general feeling of uncertainty over the economic outlook, arising from a prolonged absence of a finance minister in the island.
Mauritius Commercial Bank lost 50 cents to 69.50 rupees on 22,007 shares but State Bank of Mauritius gained 10 cents to 8.50 rupees on 201,677 shares.
Construction company Gamma Civic slumped 90 cents to 14.60 rupees on 3,600 shares but United Basalt Products climbed 10 cents to 25.10 rupees on 1,992 shares.
In the investment sector, Policy fell 20 cents to 3.10 rupees on 90,178 shares and Promotion And Development (PAD) was unchanged at 13 rupees on 11,975 shares.
